title: Indicator: Elder-Ray (Bull/Bear Power)
description: Bull Power = High - EMA(13); Bear Power = Low - EMA(13). Feeds the Elder-Ray confirmation confidence component.

checklist.step: Confirm EMA(13) is the correct reference EMA against docs/Analyse.md §4
Implement bull_power() and bear_power() in app/indicators/elder_ray.py
Write hand-computed reference-value tests for both functions in tests/unit/indicators/test_elder_ray.py
Run pytest --cov=app --cov-report=term-missing and confirm no regression

Not blocking — worth factoring into a shared helper (e.g. app/indicators/_validation.py::require_aligned_index) at some point.
